facts.text: I used to work the desk. Now I am in the field, and the field has better snacks.
facts.why: Set out as the character's own words, but the film does not have them say it. Susan's real lines in the Wikiquote list include 'Could this hotel be any more murder-y?'.
facts.fix: Could this hotel be any more murder-y?

fix_note.text: Could this hotel be any more murder-y?

facts.text: The Rome stop. Fine is buying, sort of.
facts.why: Susan's contact in Rome is Aldo, and Fine only turns up again in Budapest, so he is not in Rome buying anything.
facts.fix: The Rome stop. Aldo is the contact, sort of.

facts.text: Susan Cooper working from a basement with rats and a bat
facts.why: Susan's own line says the CIA put her in a basement with a ceiling full of bats, and a later line has Nancy saying the bats have gone, so it is bats, not one bat. Rats are in the basement too.
facts.fix: Susan Cooper working from a basement with rats and bats

vibe.verdict: The basement is a good setting, but the menu names places and cover identities rather than the film's best jokes.
